searchVersions.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field at the top of the Electron version picker's menu.

noMatches.description: Shown in the version picker's menu when the search matches no version.

copyVersion.description: Last item of the version picker's menu: copies the chosen Electron version number (or local build name) to the clipboard.

copied.description: Toast after copying the version number. {{version}} is a version such as 43.0.0, or a local build's name.
